changes.before: Introduced proposal: annual statewide data-center load reporting by the representative organization to the Power Review Board; service-cost/risk, decommissioning and community-benefit terms for a separately defined large data center (peak demand of at least 20 MW); and supplier-website disclosures. Direct comparison with enacted LB1010 shows a different data-center class starting at 10 MW, annual operator reports to the Department of Water, Energy, and Environment and Natural Resources Committee, and revised cost/decommissioning terms. The proposed section 70-1025 PRB-report amendment is absent from retained LB1010. This text comparison does not establish the AM2422 transfer path or validate the inherited PRB-minutes attribution.
changes.after: Introduced proposal: annual statewide data-center load reporting by the representative organization to the Power Review Board; service-cost/risk, decommissioning and community-benefit terms for a separately defined large data center (peak demand of at least 20 MW); and supplier-website disclosures. Direct comparison with enacted LB1010 shows a different data-center class starting at 10 MW, annual operator reports to the Department of Water, Energy, and Environment and Natural Resources Committee, and revised cost/decommissioning terms. The proposed section 70-1025 PRB-report amendment is absent from retained LB1010. AM2422 (dated March 3, filed March 6 and adopted March 12, 2026) contains the 10 MW definition and annual owner/operator reporting requirement on printed pages 17–18. The PRB March 20 minutes explicitly confirm committee removal of the proposed annual report to the PRB, but do not establish the reason for that removal. AM2422 is an intermediary amendment, not the final enacted text.

scope: Reviewed source observations, classification correction and explicit unresolved facts; all IDs retained. No current-law census asserted.
